facts.statement: Free Realms ran a Friday the 13th event in which players could join Jason Maskface to spook other players.
facts.quote: Jason wants to recruit players to celebrate Friday the 13th by having them spook other players with him.

article_summaries.title: Frightening Friday the 13th Fun!
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post announcing a Friday the 13th event: NPC Jason Maskface near Camp Chatty and Camp Robbie Lake recruits players to spook others, turning participants into creatures and granting the Scaredy Cat ability. A Friday the 13th sale ran the same day. The post date is inferred from 'posted 4 days, 4 hours ago' at the 2012-04-18 capture, and matches Friday April 13, 2012.
